title: Unit Event — Star of Your Own Story

meta.Outline: Wonderlands×Showtime have decided to work with other troupes, starting with the long-established Shunmeiza. Given a minor role with just three lines, Tsukasa faces a seemingly impossible task: to convince the director that his character is a real person.

rows.Line: Holiday - Early morning
Nonogi Park

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Pa-pe-pi-pu-pe-po-pa-po!

rows.Speaker: Nene, Rui & Emu
rows.Line: Pa-pe-pi-pu-pe-po-pa-po!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Alright, that's enough warming up!
Let's regroup!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
*Nod*
What a glorious morning! The perfect backdrop to our departure.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Anyway, are you all ready?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yup!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I'm actually a little nervous. We get to start working with another troupe today...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Yes.
Robo-Nene will have to stay behind, and we'll need to get used to a drastically different environment.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
At the same time...
I really wasn't expecting Shosuke's farewell gift to us to be so spectacular.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I feel the same way regarding that.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: He and Keisuke connected us with three different troupes.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Shunmeiza, with whom we'll be working this time around, along with the Mikazukigumi and Morinomiya troupes.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: They each have their own distinct styles, but they're all nationally renowned.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: It's so cool how we get to work with all of them!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Not only that, they all agreed to devote time to helping us improve... I honestly couldn't be more grateful.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Hehe. Me too.
So, starting today, let's learn as much as we can from everyone in Shunmeiza.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Um, so... Shunmeiza's been around for a really, really long time, right?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Correct.
It's been in business ever since before the war, so it has quite an established history.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: So much so that one of the big awards for theatrical performances is named after one of its founders.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Whoa! Is that true?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
It consists of about 200 members.
And the number is even higher if you include the directing and production teams that we'll be working with this time.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: They have some young actors, but more of them are veterans. Some have even been on TV and in movies, so you might see some familiar faces.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, I've seen a few of them perform in TV dramas... I think that most people would say that Shunmeiza produces a lot of really skilled actors.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: It's like they all know how to bring their characters to life... They make them feel so real, you know?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: They make their characters feel that real, eh...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (I've only seen videos of Shunmeiza's performances...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (But everyone I saw was absolutely spectacular. I couldn't look away for even a second.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (If I can learn how to do what they do, then I'll surely be able to take another big step as an actor.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (So, Tsukasa Tenma, get ready to learn a lot! In order to become a star who makes people smile the world over!)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. He certainly seems ready.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Now, Emu, would you mind doing the usual for us?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah, of course!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
We're gonna practice lots and lots!
We're gonna do lots and lots to make our dreams come true! And we're gonna put lots and lots of wonderhoy smiles on people's faces!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Ready, you guys?! Wonderhoy!!

rows.Speaker: Rui, Nene & Tsukasa
rows.Line: Wonderhoy!!
Several dozen minutes later
Shunmeiza - Studio

rows.Speaker: Shunmeiza Staff Member
rows.Line: The director and cast members will be arriving shortly. Please wait here for them.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Y-Yes, of course!
Thank you!
se_walk_men_002_1

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
My nerves are beginning to fray. I suppose that's only natural when you're on another troupe's home turf.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Interesting. Even the great Tsukasa gets nervous in these kinds of situations?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Of course I'm nervous!
This is nothing like anything we've done before!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
You're right, it isn't...
Even just this place. It feels completely different from the Wonder Stage.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Also, this isn't called a “stage” or “practice area”, but a “studio”, right? Why is that?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Now that you mention it, a “studio” sounds more like either buildings where they make movies or places where painters and sculptors work...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, I would imagine that most others would also think of studios as places like that.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: But a studio can actually be any place where a work of art is made. I imagine that that's why they call it that.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Really?!
That's actually kinda cool!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
I see...
...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Hm?
Is something the matter, Nene?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
No, it's just...
I didn't realize how so much thought could go into one word...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I'm starting to feel that we kinda don't belong here...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: It feels so...intellectual here...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
I see...
Yes, when you put it that way, I somewhat understand...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
But there's no need to fear!
We just need to show everyone that we're intellectual and cool by walking in with our heads held high!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yeah, with our chins way up!
I mean, we have Rui on our side!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Emu, wait...
You're making it sound like Rui's the only one who's smart!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: This is what I meant...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Now now.
I do agree that there's no need for us to worry.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, Shunmeiza's plays aren't quite the same as the shows we put on, but I'm sure they'll welcome us with open arms.
se_event_supporting_2023_002

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, someone's coming!
se_event_supporting_2023_002

rows.Speaker: Shunmeiza Director
rows.Line:
Ah, you must be Wonderlands×Showtime.
Apologies for the wait.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
(I'm seeing about twenty people.
A surprising number of them are young people.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (And I have to think this man is the...)

rows.Speaker: Shunmeiza Director
rows.Line:
It's a pleasure to meet you.
My name is Kato. I'm Shunmeiza's director, and I have the great honor of working with all of you starting from today.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (This is it! Our new chapter's finally about to begin...!!)
Shunmeiza - Studio

rows.Speaker: Shunmeiza Director
rows.Line: The president has told us all about you.

rows.Speaker: Shunmeiza Director
rows.Line: You have come to us because you wish to hone your craft as actors and stage performers, yes?

rows.Speaker: Shunmeiza Director
rows.Line:
We all wish to achieve the same.
We are very much looking forward to working with you.

rows.Speaker: Shunmeiza Members
rows.Line: Thank you for joining us!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa, Emu, Nene & Rui
rows.Line: Thank you for having us!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (So this is Shunmeiza...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Nene was right. They do have a more refined feel to them. They all look so disciplined...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (I wonder if this comes from acting as if someone is always watching them. I should start thinking the same way.)

rows.Speaker: Shunmeiza Director
rows.Line: Now, please allow me to jump right in by explaining what we'll be practicing starting today.

rows.Speaker: Shunmeiza Director
rows.Line: You will all start rehearsing with us for our next play.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Y-Your next play...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: You mean you want us to appear in it? But we're not official members. Are you sure that you want to include us?

rows.Speaker: Shunmeiza Director
rows.Line: I am. I was originally going to have you all analyze a few plays and study a few scenes...

rows.Speaker: Shunmeiza Director
rows.Line: However, since we just happened to be due to start work on our next play from today, and you already have a good deal of experience, I thought that it'd be better to have you all learn by doing.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Yes, I see...
We greatly appreciate the opportunity you're giving us.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
(I don't believe it...
We get to be in a Shunmeiza play!)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
(This is a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity!
I need to learn as much as I possibly can about what it means to perform in this troupe!)

rows.Speaker: Shunmeiza Director
rows.Line:
Now, I'll hand out the scripts.
Please check to see if there are any typos or missing pages.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
(Let's have a look...
What are we dealing with here...?)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Shunmeiza plays tend to be modern and emphasize realism. Many depict the daily lives of their characters.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (We didn't do many productions like that at the Wonder Stage, so this should be a good learning experience for us.)
se_event_supporting_2023_003
se_event_supporting_2023_003

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Hey, this looks like...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, this appears to be a play based on Kiichiro Kajiwara's “The Pomegranate”.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
The Pomegranate?
What's that about?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: The story takes place in the Showa period.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: The protagonist is a failing novelist who is struggling to make any sort of living. Tired of such a life, he has made the decision to take his own life by throwing himself off a building.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: However, as he searched for a suitable spot, he reconsiders his decision after speaking with a number of people along the way...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: The plot is fairly simple, but the story is a very heartwarming one because of how it explores the human mind.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (A story that depicts the human experience, without much melodrama... We've never done anything like this before.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (So, regardless of what role I'm given, I must do my best to adapt and try my hand at a new style of acting...!)

rows.Speaker: Shunmeiza Director
rows.Line: Now then, let's start talking about roles.

rows.Speaker: Shunmeiza Director
rows.Line: The protagonist, Ichiro Kishi, will be played by Naoki Yata.

rows.Speaker: Shunmeiza Member A
rows.Line: Thank you!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Naturally, the lead will be played by a member of this troupe.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (I would've been more than happy to audition for the role, but it can't be helped...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (That being said, I'd like to play a character that's intimately involved in the story...)

rows.Speaker: Shunmeiza Director
rows.Line: Next, Kishi's mother will be played by...

rows.Speaker: Shunmeiza Director
rows.Line: Next...

rows.Speaker: Shunmeiza Director
rows.Line: Kishi's editor, Munetsugu Hino, will be played by Reki Bakuno.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Reki Bakuno?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Hm?
Do you know him, Rui?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, but I didn't know he was a member of this troupe. I've seen quite a few of the productions he's been in.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: He's a superbly talented actor.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: He must be good if you're willing to say that much, Rui. However...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I'm yet to hear anyone respond...

rows.Speaker: Shunmeiza Director
rows.Line:
Bakuno...?
Where are you?

rows.Speaker: Shunmeiza Member B
rows.Line: Mr. Kato, I just received word that he's going to be a little late.

rows.Speaker: Shunmeiza Director
rows.Line: I see... I'll be sure to talk to him about that later. Would you mind taking his place for now?

rows.Speaker: Shunmeiza Member B
rows.Line: Happily!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: It sounds like he hasn't arrived yet.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Is he busy with a prior engagement?
I was very much looking forward to seeing him perform...

rows.Speaker: Shunmeiza Director
rows.Line:
Next...
The clerk at the used bookstore will be played by Rui Kamishiro.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Oh... Thank you.

rows.Speaker: Shunmeiza Director
rows.Line: Yuriko, the Cafe Printemps waitress, will be played by Nene Kusanagi.

rows.Speaker: Shunmeiza Director
rows.Line: Chiyo, the Cafe Printemps regular, will be played by Emu Otori.

rows.Speaker: Shunmeiza Director
rows.Line: Lastly...

rows.Speaker: Shunmeiza Director
rows.Line: Hino's coworker and fellow editor, Nakayama, will be played by Tsukasa Tenma.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Thank you!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
(He'll be playing Hino's coworker...
And Hino himself will be played by Bakuno.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
(In other words...
I get to watch Tsukasa and Bakuno perform alongside each other.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
(Nakayama, eh...?
I flipped through the script rather quickly, but I didn't see his name anywhere.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (He must be a fairly minor character.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (But I'm still going to do my absolute best! So, let's check through the script again!)
se_event_supporting_2023_003
se_event_supporting_2023_003

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Nakayama, Nakayama... Hm?)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: “Morning.”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: “That novelist giving you trouble again?”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: “No choice, I suppose.”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (It's normal for a minor character like this to have only a few lines... Still...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: How am I supposed to prepare for a role like this?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Up until now...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (I learned how to play my characters by dissecting their lines and finding anything that I had in common with them.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (But in this case...)

rows.Speaker: Shunmeiza Director
rows.Line: Alright, I'll give you all some time to read through the script. Once you've done that, please start considering how to play your respective roles. You have...thirty minutes.

rows.Speaker: Shunmeiza Director
rows.Line: Starting now.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
(I don't have time to worry.
All I can do now is figure something out by familiarizing myself with the story...!)
se_event_supporting_2023_003
se_event_supporting_2023_003
Thirty minutes later

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hmm...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
(Okay, I understand what happens now.
However...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (I still don't know what Nakayama is actually like. All I learned is how he's the editor for a literary magazine and is good friends with his coworker Hino... Not much more than that.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
(I need more information.
How am I supposed to even imagine this character, let alone grasp his personality and emotional state...?)
se_run_men_002_1
I'm sorry for being late!!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hm?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Is that...?
Shunmeiza - Studio

rows.Speaker: Shunmeiza Director
rows.Line: Care to explain why you're late, Bakuno?

rows.Speaker: Reki
rows.Line:
I-I'm sorry...
Something came up at my part-time job and...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Bakuno...?
That means...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (He's Reki Bakuno. The “superbly talented actor” Rui just mentioned.)

rows.Speaker: Shunmeiza Director
rows.Line: I'll give you a pass this time.

rows.Speaker: Shunmeiza Director
rows.Line: But since everyone from Wonderlands×Showtime is here, why don't you introduce yourself to them first?

rows.Speaker: Reki
rows.Line: Y-You're really here...!

rows.Speaker: Reki
rows.Line: Um, I need to apologize for running late to practice...

rows.Speaker: Reki
rows.Line:
I-It's nice to meet—
I mean, m-my name is... I'm sorry. I'm not used to doing this...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I can kinda relate to this guy...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: (He's just like Nene when we first met her!)

rows.Speaker: Reki
rows.Line: M-My name is... Reki Bakuno... I'm looking forward to working with all of you...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Likewise!

rows.Speaker: Shunmeiza Director
rows.Line: We'll be taking five and doing a table read right after, Bakuno. Will you be able to join us?

rows.Speaker: Reki
rows.Line:
Y-Yes.
I should be able to...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hm? Is something wrong, Rui?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: It's just... Remember how I said he was superbly talented when I saw him on stage?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: But seeing him like this... I'm honestly having a hard time believing that he's the same person who I saw.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Of course, I understand that he would seem like a different person when he's in character, but still...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Hmm...
So, his acting skills are just that good?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, that may be the case.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Still...)

rows.Speaker: Reki
rows.Line: ...yes...which is why...is how...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (It took me thirty minutes to read through this script, but he only has five... What's he going to do?)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (His character, Hino the editor, also doesn't have that many lines. Deciding how to play him doesn't seem easy.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
(His lines are similar to Nakayama's.
They all involve work.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
(He only has two lines for the opening scene.
“That's going to be a problem, Kishi,” and, “This is it. No more chances.”)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (His lines later on don't stand out all that much either...)

rows.Speaker: Reki
rows.Line: I'm finished.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
(What...? Already?
But he has so little information to work with. He already knows how he's going to play his character...?)

rows.Speaker: Shunmeiza Director
rows.Line: Then, let's begin our table read.

rows.Speaker: Shunmeiza Director
rows.Line:
Oh, before I forget.
Everyone, please feel free to stand up and move around if you deem it necessary. Try to stay loose.

rows.Speaker: Everyone
rows.Line: Understood!

rows.Speaker: Shunmeiza Director
rows.Line: Alright, begin.

rows.Speaker: Shunmeiza Member A
rows.Line: “The old gramophone in the parlor was playing something I hadn't heard in a very long time.”

rows.Speaker: Shunmeiza Member A
rows.Line: “Hearing that warm and beautiful sound made up my mind. To end my life here and now.”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
(He's only narrating, but it's so captivating...
Shunmeiza certainly knows how to deliver.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (No, stop acting like a member of the audience. Focus on his acting.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (First is this soliloquy by the protagonist, the failing novelist Kishi.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Then, we learn about the setting in which he lives.)

rows.Speaker: Shunmeiza Member C
rows.Line: “Ichiro! What is the meaning of this? Why haven't you been in touch? Your father is still waiting for you to come home. Honestly, it's high time that you quit being a novelist and took over the family business.”

rows.Speaker: Shunmeiza Member D
rows.Line:
“I'm sorry, Kishi...
I need to raise your rent soon, and...”

rows.Speaker: Shunmeiza Member E
rows.Line: “I heard that a strange man's been wandering around here lately. He's dressed shabbily, has messy hair... Ah, there. Just like that one. Be careful, everyone.”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (His mother back in the countryside wants him to come home and take over the family business, he's likely going to get evicted when his rent goes up and people around town believe he's some kind of vagrant.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (And now, on top of all that, his editor's going to tell him that he's out of chances when he asks for another extension on his deadline.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
(Enter Bakuno.
Playing the editor, Hino.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (How is he going to play him...?)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Reki
rows.Line: “That's going to be a problem, Kishi.”

rows.Speaker: Shunmeiza Member A
rows.Line:
“P-Please, I beg you...!
Just three more days! I promise to have my manuscript ready by then...!”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (I didn't recognize him for a second...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (He's nothing like how he was a second ago. Not only that...)
se_walk_men_002_1

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (The way he's moving and speaking. It feels so real...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (This isn't the first time Kishi's asked for an extension. Hino's clearly had it up to here with him.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (In the script, Hino lets it slide but says, “No more chances.”)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (But... Unless...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Is Kishi about to lose his job?)
se_walk_men_002_1

rows.Speaker: Reki
rows.Line: “This is it.”

rows.Speaker: Reki
rows.Line: “No more chances.”

rows.Speaker: Shunmeiza Member A
rows.Line: “I understand...”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
(Yes... Of course.
He can't get fired. It's right there in the script.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
(And yet...
I was just overcome with the feeling that Hino had finally had enough of Kishi's antics.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (He can even make someone who already knows the plot do a double take.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (What an incredible actor...!)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(What... What just happened...?
It's like he turned into a completely different person...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (His abilities may be unparalleled.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (We've previously encountered some talented actors around our age, such as Asahi and Seiryuin...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (But to be able to produce such a fleshed-out performance in such a short amount of time... Even they would have trouble accomplishing such a feat.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (No, I don't have time to marvel at his performance! The scene where he and Nakayama talk is coming up!)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Based on his lines, Nakayama seems like a younger fellow. But as the two are friendly with each other, I imagine he's been at this magazine for a little while, so I'd say he's in his late twenties.)

rows.Speaker: Reki
rows.Line: “Good morning.”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Okay, that's my cue...!)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: “Morning.”

rows.Speaker: Shunmeiza Member F
rows.Line: “What took you so long to get back, Hino?”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: “That novelist giving you trouble again?”

rows.Speaker: Reki
rows.Line:
“Bingo.
Chief, he asked for another extension. He's really cutting it close this time.”

rows.Speaker: Shunmeiza Member F
rows.Line: “Honestly, that no good...”

rows.Speaker: Shunmeiza Member F
rows.Line:
“This will be his last month.
'Shiranami' may mean 'white-crested waves', but we don't want anyone taking the magazine through rough seas.”

rows.Speaker: Reki
rows.Line: “Understood.”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: “No choice, I suppose.”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (I don't feel like a part of the conversation. I'm just giving them replies. How do I become Nakayama like Bakuno has become Hino...?)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
(More to the point...
Am I even playing this character right...?)

rows.Line: Even though that scene was very short, I was able to see your character's life story.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Shunmeiza Director
rows.Line: So, you've succeeded in the task I gave you. Next time, try to think about the play as a whole while maintaining your fervent passion for acting.

rows.Speaker: Shunmeiza Director
rows.Line:
It won't be easy...
But I wish you the best of luck.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Thank you very much!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Congratulations, Tsukasa!
Hip hip hooray!!!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I'm not sure I deserve to be congratulated. I mean, I did sort of stick out like a sore thumb during the show...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
But you took a pretty big step.
I think you should be happy.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
She's right, Tsukasa.
You managed to break out of your shell.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: All of you...!

rows.Speaker: Reki
rows.Line: Tenma! Everyone!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Oh, Bakuno!
Nice work today!

rows.Speaker: Reki
rows.Line:
Likewise.
Thanks to all of you, I ended up having a lot of fun putting on this play. Also...

rows.Speaker: Reki
rows.Line: Thank you very much.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Huh?
No, we should be the ones thanking you...

rows.Speaker: Reki
rows.Line:
That's not true.
Meeting you, Tenma...

rows.Speaker: Reki
rows.Line: You made me want to try being the lead.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Reki
rows.Line: As I mentioned the other day, my goal as an actor has been to shine a light on characters who I think deserve more attention.

rows.Speaker: Reki
rows.Line: But something hit me while talking to you, Tenma.

rows.Speaker: Reki
rows.Line: It doesn't matter if a character's in a leading or supporting role...

rows.Speaker: Reki
rows.Line: I realized that for me, the fun part of playing characters has been considering their lives as I do.

rows.Speaker: Reki
rows.Line: Labelling characters as “leading” or “supporting” is disrespectful in a way since they're still human beings with lives of their own.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Bakuno...

rows.Speaker: Reki
rows.Line: I've turned down several offers before, but I've decided to be proactive and ask to play the lead in a movie...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
What...?!
Really?!

rows.Speaker: Reki
rows.Line:
Yes.
You gave me the push I needed, Tenma.

rows.Speaker: Reki
rows.Line: So, thank you.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I helped you?! I'm so honored!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Despite receiving so much help this time around, I wasn't able to produce any results on stage...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (But I was able to take another big step as an actor.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Not only that...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (I'm so glad I could make Bakuno smile.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
(So!
I should take what I experienced and use it to propel myself further forward!)

rows.Speaker: Reki
rows.Line: Oh, that reminds me...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Is something the matter?

rows.Speaker: Reki
rows.Line: The movie I'm about to work on is also going to include a few others from Shunmeiza...

rows.Speaker: Reki
rows.Line:
But they still need more extras.
So, if you'd like, would you all like to apply to be in it?

rows.Speaker: Emu & Nene
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa & Rui
rows.Line: A movie...?!
